facts.content: A 40-year-old female has a 2-day history of wheeze after dust exposure during house cleaning.
facts.source_text: 40 y/o F with 2-day hx wheeze after dust exposure during house cleaning

facts.content: The patient reports shortness of breath and difficulty completing sentences.
The patient reports adequate oral intake of approximately 4 to 5 glasses of water per day.
The patient has a history of childhood asthma that is mostly resolved.
The patient has occasional exercise-induced respiratory symptoms.
The patient has hay fever in summer.
The patient is not on any current medications except for use of an old asthma inhaler about two months ago.
facts.source_text: No current meds except old asthma inhaler (~2 months ago)

facts.content: The patient does not have antihistamines at home.
The patient has no known allergies.
The patient had dust exposure during house cleaning.
Acute wheeze is thought to be an asthma exacerbation or allergic reaction triggered by dust exposure.
facts.source_text: Acute wheeze likely asthma exacerbation or allergic reaction triggered by dust exposure

facts.content: There is a history of childhood asthma with incomplete resolution and possible intermittent active disease.
facts.source_text: History of childhood asthma with incomplete resolution; possible intermittent active disease

facts.content: The patient is to be urgently referred to a clinic for examination and diagnostic tests including pulse oximetry.
facts.source_text: Urgent referral to clinic for examination and diagnostic tests (including pulse oximetry)

facts.content: Over-the-counter antihistamines are recommended if allergy is suspected prior to the clinic visit.
facts.source_text: Recommend over-the-counter antihistamines if allergy suspected, prior to clinic visit

facts.content: There may be a need for steroids depending on test results.
facts.source_text: Possible need for steroids depending on test results

facts.content: The general practitioner will be notified with a letter for continued care and follow-up.
facts.source_text: Notify GP with letter for continued care and follow-up
